message.content:
Closures get changed all the time—sometimes multiple times in a single day. The authorities might widen a restricted zone because of an event, or they’ll move the end time of a closure if something unexpected happens, like a protest or a weather alert.

For example, I remember one time a closure near a port was expanded suddenly because of a ship traffic issue. Halfway through the day, the rules changed, and drones already in the air had to reroute or land early. It messed up a few deliveries, and we had to call off a couple of inspections because the drones couldn’t get back safely.

We get updates through the platform, but sometimes the changes come so fast that dispatchers have to double-check the latest rules before signing off a flight.
